cards.card_text: Then the LORD talks about the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task.
cards.verse_text: Behold, I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task; and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc.
